changeSet.comment: nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks: the quarantine restore verb's move. DELETE ... RETURNING from the quarantine sibling into an INSERT into the origin in one statement under the exclusive sweep gate, for chashes the caller names (no manifest row needed); a chash already in the origin is skipped, never overwritten (a different embedding width is reported as dim_conflict); the restored row takes last_written_at = now() so it is not immediately reapable and the result says on what date it is again; one quarantine_restore gc_audit row with the full chash list per call that restores anything; one result row per requested chash (restored, would_restore, present, dim_conflict, missing). Dry-run form classifies only.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.quarantine_restore_chunks(text, text, text, text[], text, bigint, boolean);
